name: writetighter
description: Check drafted prose with the writetighter CLI before shipping — deterministic lint plus contextual revision. Reports rule findings and model-suggested rewrites; you apply them.

interface.longDescription: Use WriteTighter from Codex to lint and revise drafted prose — PR descriptions, plans, docs, commit bodies, code comments — before it ships. Run the deterministic `lint` and contextual `revise` commands, apply only the changes you can verify, and surface clarification questions instead of guessing.
defaultPrompt: Tighten this drafted prose with writetighter before I ship it — lint and revise, then apply the changes you can verify.
Run writetighter on the comments introduced in this PR and propose tighter versions.
Check this README section with writetighter and tell me what's loose.
